GUIDELINES FOR THE APPLICATION OF 
MALAYSIA INTERNATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP (MIS) 2026 
Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS) 2026 
WHO CAN 
APPLY 
 Graduates from the recipient countries of MIS 2026 who: 
1. are citizens from the recipient countries* of MIS 2026; 
2. intend to pursue full-time postgraduate studies 
(Master’s/PhD) in Malaysia; or 
3. are currently pursuing full-time postgraduate studies in 
Malaysian public universities and selected private higher 
education institutions** wit

h a minimum of two (2) 
semesters remaining before the end of the study period. 
 
* please refer to the list of Recipient Countries of MIS 2026 below 
**please refer to the List of Universities below to view universities 
and institutions included under MIS 
RECIPIENT 
COUNTRIES 
OF MIS 2026 
High potential and excellent graduates from the following 
countries are welcome to apply for MIS: 
• ASEAN* countries 
(Brunei Darussalam, 
Cambodia, Indonesia, 
Lao PDR, Myanmar, 
Philippines, Singapore,

Thailand and Vietnam) 
• Commonwealth countries 
(CPA** regions of Africa, Asia, 
Australia, British Islands & 
Mediterranean, Canada, The 
Caribbean, Americas & The 
Atlantic, India and the Pacific) 
• Afghanistan • Libya 
• Albania • Morocco 
• Algeria • Palestine 
• Azerbaijan • Qatar 
• Bahrain • Russia 
• Brazil • Saudi Arabia 
• Chile • Senegal 
• China • Serbia 
• Egypt • South Korea 
• Georgia • Sudan 
• Hong Kong • Syria

2 
 
• Hungary • Tajikistan 
• Iran • Timor-Leste 
• Iraq • Tunisia 
• Japan • Turkiye 
• Jordan • Turkmenistan 
• Kazakhstan • United Arab Emirates 
• Kosovo • Uzbekistan 
• Kuwait • Yemen 
• Kyrgyzstan 
*ASEAN: Association of Southeast Asian Nations 
**CPA: Commonwealth Parliamentary Association 
HOW TO 
APPLY 
1. Application for MIS can be accessed on our online 
application system via the link 
https://biasiswa.mohe.gov.my/INTER/index.php 
 
2. Applicants will have to fill up and provide all

the necessary 
information in the Application Form and have the 
compulsory documents listed below scanned and saved in 
PDF format and uploaded: 
 
i. A certified copy of the passport as evidence of 
nationality (with a minimum validity of 6 months); 
ii. A certified copy of the academic transcript(s): 
a. Transcripts of undergraduate studies (together 
with the master’s degree transcript for PhD 
applicants); 
b. Reflect the record of all the courses taken 
throughout the previous study progr

amme(s); and 
c. Must be submitted together with a certified 
official document issued by the applicant’s 
alma mater describing the institution’s grade 
system if the applicant’s transcript does not

3 
 
include information on CGPA, marks or score 
percentile. 
iii. A certified copy of English Proficiency test result 
(IELTS / TOEFL) or an official letter from the previous 
institution declaring English as the medium of 
instruction used for the obtained degree(s); 
iv. Letter of Recommendation from two (2) referees; 
v. Admission letter to Malaysian university (if applicants 
are currently undertaking postgraduate studies or if 
applicants have secured admission to the university); 
vi. Cu

rriculum Vitae; and 
vii. Research Proposal *for Masters by Research and 
PhD applicants only 
**all documents are required to be in English, if they are in any 
language other than English, you are required to provide certified 
translated copies of the documents. 
ELIGIBILITY 
CRITERIA 
Applicants must fulfil the following criteria for their applications 
to be considered further: 
1. Is not more than 40 years old at the time of application 
for Master’s degree. 
2. Is not more than 45 years o

ld at the time of application 
for PhD level. 
3. Possess good academic qualifications: 
i. Master’s applicants: obtained a CGPA of 3.00 / 
2nd Class Upper (Honours) or higher at the 
bachelor’s degree level; 
ii. PhD applicants: obtained a CGPA of 3.00 / 
excellent results at the Master’s level in courses 
related to the intended PhD study program 
4. Good proficiency of English Language: 
i. IELTS band 6.0 or higher; or

4 
 
ii. Total score of 550 or higher in TOEFL paper-
based test (PBT) or equivalent score in other 
TOEFL tests; or 
iii. Has obtained previous degree(s) with English 
used as the medium of instructions (must submit 
an official declaration by the university). 
5. Submit a written research proposal* with a minimum of 
1,000 words that is relevant to the intended field of 
studies 
*for Master’s by Research and PhD applicants only 
LEVEL OF 
STUDY 
1. Master’s degree 
2. Doctor of Philosophy (Ph

D) degree 
*Full-time study only 
LIST OF 
UNIVERSITIES 
Institutions listed below are supported under MIS: 
 
Public Universites: 
1. Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) 
2. Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM) 
3. Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM) 
4. Universiti Malaya (UM) 
5. Universiti Teknologi Mara (UiTM) 
6. Universiti Islam Antarabangsa Malaysia (UIAM/IIUM) 
7. Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM) 
8. Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM) 
9. Universiti Tun Hussein Onn Malaysia (UTHM) 
10. Universit

i Teknikal Malaysia Melaka (UTEM) 
11. Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM) 
12. Universiti Pendidikan Sultan Idris (UPSI) 
13. Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT) 
14. Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) 
15. Universiti Malaysia Pahang (UMP) 
16. Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)

5 
 
17. Universiti Malaysia Perlis (UNIMAP) 
18. Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin (UNISZA) 
19. Universiti Pertahanan Nasional Malaysia (UPNM) 
20. Universiti Malaysia Kelantan (UMK) 
Private Universities: 
21. Universiti Teknologi Petronas (UTP) 
22. Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN) 
23. Multimedia University (MMU) 
24. INCEIF University (INCEIF) 
BENEFITS OF 
MIS 
1. Tuition fees for the entire sponsorship period will be paid 
directly to the university upon the issuance of invoice to 
MOHE

by the university. 
2. Monthly living allowance of RM 1,500.00 per month will be 
paid to the scholars every four (4) months upon the 
submission of scholars’ progress report to MOHE. 
AREAS OF 
STUDY 
Applicants are welcome to apply for any accredited courses with 
priorities given to courses under the following areas of study: 
1. Education 
2. Arts and Humanities 
3. Social Sciences, Journalism and Information 
4. Business, Administration and Law 
5. Natural Sciences, Mathematics and Statist

ics 
6. Information and Communication Technologies 
7. Engineering, Manufacturing and Construction 
8. Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries and Veterinary 
9. Health and Welfare *not including medicine, nursing and 
pharmacy 
SELECTION 
CRITERIA 
Applications will be considered according to the following 
selection criteria: 
1. Outstanding academic and co-curricular achievement.

6 
 
2. The quality of the research proposal and its potential 
contribution towards advancement of technology and 
human well-being, with a preference for Malaysia-related 
research topics. 
3. Excellent communication, writing and reading skills in 
English language. 
TERMS AND 
CONDITION 
1. Scholars must enroll into full-time study for postgraduate 
programs. It is the responsibility of the scholars to confirm 
their admission to the university. 
2. Scholars must not change their study progra

m during the 
tenure of the scholarship except with written permission from 
the university and MOHE. 
3. Scholars must fulfil the requirements of the study program 
and abide by Malaysian laws and the university’s rules, 
regulations, and codes of conduct. 
4. Any suspension from the university will result in the scholar’s 
immediate suspension of the scholarship. Monthly 
allowances are not payable during the suspension. 
5. It is the responsibility of the successful candidates to apply 
and m

eet the requirements for the issuing of an appropriate 
entry visa, including a medical examination. The offer of the 
scholarship does not guarantee the granting of a visa. 
Further information and application details are available at 
https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my. 
6. Scholars must maintain satisfactory academic progress and 
good standing throughout the study duration as stipulated by 
their host university, failure to do so will result in the 
scholarship being withdrawn. 
7. The sc

holarships are tenable in Malaysian universities and 
higher education institutes and research must be carried out 
in Malaysia.

7 
 
8. Scholars are not allowed to take any paid employment during 
the scholarship tenure unless they have written approval 
from the host university. 
CONTACT 
INFORMATION 
 
For further enquiries regarding MIS, please contact: 
 
SCHOLARSHIP DIVISION 
Ministry of Higher Education 
Level 2, No 2, Tower 2, 
Jalan P5/6, Precinct 5, 
62200 PUTRAJAYA 
 
Phone: +603-8870 6346 / +603-8870 6375 
(9.00 am – 4.30 pm Malaysia time / Monday - Friday) 
E-mail: international@mohe.gov.my 
 
For any technic

al assistance regarding MIS application form, 
please submit an e-mail with screenshot(s) of the issue to: 
international@mohe.gov.my

GUIDELINES 
FOR THE MALAYSIAN TECHNICAL COOPERATION PROGRAMME 
(MTCP) SCHOLARSHIP 2026 
 
 
1. GENERAL INFO ON THE MTCP SCHOLARSHIP: 
● The application for the Scholarship is open from 4 May 2026 until 12 June 
2026. 
● Interested applicants may apply for the MTCP Scholarship through the MTCP 
website at https://mtcp.kln.gov.my/scholarship. 
● This scholarship is open for full-time Master’s Degree only for the September/ 
October intake for the academic year of 2026/2027. 
● The S

cholarship is offered to outstanding graduates from the MTCP recipient 
countries as listed in the MTCP Scholarship website. 
 
 
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: 
● Applicants must comply with the following criteria: 
a) Not more than 45 years old at the time of application; 
b) Obtain a minimum of Second Class Upper (Honours) or a minimum 
CGPA of 3.0 or equivalent at the Undergraduate level; 
c) Provide proof of English Language Proficiency: 
⮚ Scanned copy of the original proof of English Language P

roficiency 
such as IELTS (minimum total score 6) or TOEFL internet-based test 
(minimum total score of 60); or 
⮚ Has obtained a previous degree(s) with English used as the medium 
of instruction. 
d) Excellent level of health certified by a doctor/ physician. The cost of the 
medical check-up shall be fully borne by the applicant. Medical report form 
can be downloaded from the MTCP Scholarship website. The Medical 
Report must be valid within six (6) months from the date of application.

3. APPLICATION PROCESS: 
● Interested applicants are required to register and apply for MTCP Scholarship 
through the system at https://mtcp.kln.gov.my/register_scholarship. 
● The system utilised for registration shall also be used for the entire application 
and selection procedure. Applicants may be required to log in to the system at 
different stages of the process to obtain updates on the status of their 
application or to provide supplementary documents. 
*Note: Only applications that hav

e been submitted into the system will be 
considered. 
Applications that are found to contain inaccurate or falsified information may be 
subject to disqualification.

4. SCHOLARSHIP BENEFITS: 
a) Tuition fees for the whole sponsorship period will be paid directly to the 
university upon issuance of invoice by the university; 
b) Monthly allowance will be paid directly to your Malaysian bank account; and 
c) A one-time economy class flight ticket from the student’s closest international 
airport to Malaysia for the start of the scholarship programme and a return

Not applicable for Nursing, Medicine & Clinical Pharmacy courses 
 
 
6. SELECTION CRITERIA: 
Applications will be considered according to the following selection criteria: 
i. High-level academic and extra-curricular achievement; 
ii. Excellent proficiency in English (communication, writing and reading); and 
iii. Demonstrated preparation for the chosen programme of study. 
 
 
7. TERMS AND CONDITIONS: 
i. Recipients must undertake a full-time Master’s Degree programme in 
Malaysia, preferably

in public universities, during the period as stated in the 
Scholarship Offer Letter. 
ii. Recipients must not change their programme during the tenure of the 
scholarship, except with written permission from the university and the MTCP 
Secretariat. 
iii. Recipients must fulfil the requirements of the study programme and abide by 
Malaysian laws and the university’s rules, regulations and codes of conduct. 
iv. Any suspension from the university will result in immediate suspension of the 
award

. Monthly allowances are not payable during the suspension. 
v. It is the responsibility of successful recipients to apply and meet the 
requirements for the issuing of an appropriate entry visa including medical 
examination. The cost of the visa application shall be fully borne by the 
recipients. Further information and application details are available at 
https://visa.educationmalaysia.gov.my/. 
vi. Recipients must maintain satisfactory academic progress and good standing 
throughout the st

udy duration as stipulated by their host university. Failure to 
do so will result in the scholarship being withdrawn.

viii. Recipients are not allowed to take any paid employment during their tenure

Secretariat.
